verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm agent-oriented docs are live. https://vercel.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured llms.txt, the AI Gateway docs page has a markdown version with frontmatter at /docs/ai-gateway.md, and a machine-readable openapi.json is served. A products.md markdown page also covers AI Gateway. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is Vercel-wide rather than an AI Gateway-specific index, and no first-party documentation describes or commits to the agent-docs offering.
